scope: Actual workflow CONFIG/AUTH gates and existing local contract-test executable only.

root_cause: On the installed /bin/bash 3.2.57, errexit did not stop execution after standalone failing [[ ... ]] expressions. The CONFIG fragment's later successful checks masked earlier failures. Marker extraction and whitespace were not the cause.

reproduction.actual_extracted_gate: Same CONFIG gate with synthetic public environment and GITHUB_REF=refs/heads/main, /bin/bash -eux -o pipefail; trace shows failed initial comparison, subsequent checks execute, final status 0. No real credential was used or printed.

fix: Append explicit || exit 1 to each actual CONFIG/AUTH guard, making rejection independent of shell errexit behavior. No Rust test or production source changed.
review_independence: selector_tests authored only this narrow explicit-exit correction while acting as debugger; parent must review these changed guard lines independently. The remaining workflow infrastructure review is separate.
